messages:
maria: Quick status — vendor sent a soft-standby offer for extra H100 capacity for a 48h window. eu-west1, preemptible, 12xH100. Offer expires EOD today. Who wants us to hold any of it? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: Do we know eviction behavior for their preemptible SKU? windows / chance?
sasha: Vendor emailed: 'best-effort preemptible with <5% eviction probability per 24h sliding window; no hard SLA.' Not great but maybe fine for canaries.
ria: For the weekend canary I only need 4 GPUs for ~6h. If we hold the whole 48h pool that's wasteful. Can we request a partial hold?
samir: Serving team wants a small warm pool + ability to scale to +8 on short notice. If vendor supports a soft hold on 4 and standby on the rest that'd be ideal.
vendor-ops: We can do a "soft hold" API that pins capacity for 48h with a 6h billing minimum per instance. To accept via API: `curl -X POST "https://vendor.example/api/holds" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"region":"eu-west1","gpu":"h100","count":4,"hours":48}'`
kevin: Price? any min-billing or teardown penalties?
vendor-ops: Price = €2.10 / GPU-hr, billing increments of 1h, min billing per GPU = 6h for holds. No early-teardown penalty but refund only pro-rata.
maria: Cost sounds OK for the canary if finance signs off. Can we ask them to split invoice_code so we can attribute to SERVING-CANARY and INFRA-WARMPOOL?
finance: Finance: we need a quick cost estimate line item. If maria posts the exact qty/hours we can pre-approve up to €600 for the weekend.
maria: OK — holding request for 4 GPUs x 6h for canary (SERVING-CANARY) + soft-standby 8 GPUs x up to 42h (INFRA-WARMPOOL) pending finance. I'll not accept the vendor offer until we have finance ack. If no reply by 17:00 UTC I'll release the standby. :memo: 
kevin: I'll open a tiny billing PR to allocate codes, pinging @samir on the PR.
samir: +1, will review fast.
devops-bot: INFRA-1942 created and updated: "soft-standby hold request (vendor: example)". Current status: awaiting finance approval. Link: https://infra.tickets/INFRA-1942
maria: Thanks — keeping this thread for updates. If finance approves before 17:00 I'll flip the accept switch via the API above.
